steps.name: Open Full Computer
steps.goal: If iOS asks permission to paste, tap Allow Paste first. Tap only the Full Computer button in the native fixture header at the top. Do not tap any stream toolbar button. This switches to the Full Computer viewer and resets the test.
steps.done: The header says exactly Clipboard fixture · Full Computer and Waiting for paste is visible.

steps.name: 1 Paste in Full Computer
steps.goal: Tap Paste from this device in the stream toolbar. If iOS asks, tap Allow Paste.
steps.done: Pasted is visible in the clipboard status.

steps.name: Verify paste in Full Computer
steps.goal: Wait for Remote paste verified. Do not tap any button and do not type.
steps.done: Remote paste verified is visible, proving exact Unicode text reached the remote form once.

steps.name: Select text in Full Computer
steps.goal: Tap Select remote text in the native header. Do not tap Copy yet.
steps.done: Selection ready is visible in the native header.

steps.name: 1 Copy in Full Computer
steps.goal: Tap Copy selected text from the Computer in the stream toolbar. Then wait for Device copy verified.
steps.done: The native header says exactly Clipboard fixture · Full Computer. Device copy verified and Remote paste verified are both visible, proving the native clipboard contains the exact remote Unicode text.
